items.title: Humana Shares Fall Despite Second-Quarter Earnings Beat and Reaffirmed Outlook

items.title: Humana (NYSE:HUM) Exceeds Q2 CY2026 Expectations
items.summary: Health insurance company Humana (NYSE:HUM) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 26.2% year on year to $40.87 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $7.61 per share was 8.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Humana (HUM) Q2 Earnings and Revenues Top Estimates
items.summary: Humana (HUM) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +22.35% and +0.59%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
